source.rights: Facts-only original methodological notes;no textbook corpus,figures or implementation copied. NOAA numerical subset retains attribution/public-domain policy. No Chronos assets acquired.

source.vintage: Retrospective evaluation on a fixed revised data snapshot. QC/calibration/midmonth corrections and2022–2023Maunakea substitution;historical publication vintages unverified. Prefix isolation does not prove historical source availability.

evaluation.weighting: Macro weights series equally;micro weights scored cells equally. With one series they coincide. MASE uses per-origin scales.
evaluation.dependence: Forecast windows overlap;300cells/model/partition represent36distinct NOAA target months,not300independent trials. No naive significance tests.
evaluation.vintage: Retrospective evaluation on a fixed revised data snapshot;historical publication vintages are unverified. Software prefix isolation does not prove as-of historical data availability.

resource_policy: Measured separately and frozen by hash;pure deterministic forecasts contain no fabricated runtime measurements.
